overview.text: The National Anti-Corruption Commission, through its National Anti-Corruption Commissioner, published an investigation report on Operation Kingscliff.
overview.support: This report uses pseudonyms for the protagonists and for witnesses.

overview.text: The investigation examined whether a Senior Executive Service staff member in the Department of Home Affairs used her position to influence the recruitment of her sister's fiancé, and to assist her sister in another recruitment process.
overview.support: had improperly used her position to influence the recruitment of her sister's fiancé

overview.text: The Commission found that the official abused her public office in procuring the transfer of her sister's fiancé, and that she abused her office and misused official information by providing interview questions to her sister.
overview.support: The Commission found that this was an abuse by the official of her public office

overview.text: The Commission did not find that the official's sister or her fiancé engaged in corrupt conduct.
overview.support: The Commission did not find that the official's sister

overview.text: The report made three recommendations, concerning managing conflicts of interest in recruitment, limiting access to interview questions, and specific Home Affairs policies.
overview.support: Reduce the risk of undisclosed conflicts of interest in recruitment

findings.quote: The Commission found that this was an abuse by the official of her public office: she used her position to procure the transfer of her sister's fiancé into the Department for the purpose of benefitting her sister's fiancé and her sister, knowing it to be improper.

The Commission found that this was an abuse by the official of her public office and a misuse by her of official information: she provided official information in the form of interview questions, to which she had access because of her position, to her sister, to give her sister an advantage in the recruitment process, knowing it to be improper.
I therefore do not find that Mr Elbert engaged in corrupt conduct.
I therefore do not find that Melissa engaged in corrupt conduct.
